excerpt: The NUCLEUS experiment aims to measure coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering (CEvNS) at unprecedentedly low nuclear recoil energies using gram-scale cryogenic calorimeters operated at the Chooz nuclear power plant in France ... incorporating a data-driven treatment of the low-energy excess (LEE) observed during commissioning ... For the Technical Run with a 7 g CaWO4 target, we find competitive sensitivity ... For the Physics Run ... we project a 4.7 sigma observation of CEvNS.
title: Prospect of the NUCLEUS Experiment at Chooz for Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering and New Physics Searches
